mismatches.question: If a member of the public is injured on my business premises, am I covered?
mismatches.rationale: p.17 covers awards of damages for accidental bodily injury/property damage to third parties.

mismatches.question: Does my public liability cover an incident that happens outside the UK?
mismatches.rationale: p.6 restricts cover to GB/NI/Channel Islands/Isle of Man.
